t: You're at Clapham Common tube station, on the Morden branch of the Northern line, between Clapham North and Clapham South, in fare zone 2. The station was designed by Charles Holden, the architect best known for many London Underground stations in the 1920s and 1930s, as well as the Underground's headquarters at 55 Broadway and Senate House for the University of London. So the building in front of you is part of that larger story of Underground design. The footballer James Phillips, a Scottish half back, is recorded as having died here.
